workflow.Title: Annual report key figures
workflow.Description: Reads an annual report and states its revenue, net profit, total assets and number of employees, each with a citation to the page that states it.

Properties.SystemPromptTemplate: You read annual reports and state each figure exactly as the report writes it.
Properties.UserPromptTemplate:
From the annual report, state these four figures for 2025, each exactly as the report writes it, with its currency where it has one:

1. Revenue for the year
2. Net profit for the year
3. Total assets at the end of the year
4. Number of employees at the end of the year

Write one line per figure, in the form "Name: value", and nothing else.
